title: Camouflage Block
description: Use the camouflage block to play a prank on your friends
body:
# Overview
## Supported Languages
Currently, only Simplified Chinese is supported, but translations for some items have not yet been added.
## Camouflage Blocks
At present, only one type of camouflage block has been added: camouflaged dirt.
## Loose Dirt Clumps
These can be obtained by breaking loose dirt blocks, which can be created by right-clicking on dirt with a ‘plough’.
# Recipe Book
Please see the image
# Items
Includes the Plough, Loose Soil Clumps, and Loose Soil Blocks, etc.
## Plough
I have designed this to be a core tool.
## Loose Soil Blocks
Obtained by right-clicking on soil blocks with the Plough; they are affected by gravity and, when destroyed, yield 1–3 Loose Soil Clumps.
## Loose Soil Clumps
Used solely for crafting
## Camouflaged Soil
### Crafting Recipe
Crafted using 3 sticks and 4 loose soil clumps
### Behaviour
Entities will destroy it upon stepping on it, dropping 1–3 sticks and 1–4 loose soil clumps
